question: Where was the 55th World Economic Forum Annual Meeting, 2025, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Switzerland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 55th World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting in 2025 was held in **Switzerland**.
 
• Switzerland has been the traditional venue for the World Economic Forum, specifically in the town of **Davos**, which is renowned for hosting global leaders and industry experts.
 
• The WEF Annual Meeting serves as a platform for addressing global economic, social, and environmental challenges by bringing together leaders from politics, business, and civil society.
 
• The forum's theme for 2025 continued its focus on fostering international cooperation and addressing pressing global issues such as climate change, technological advancements, and economic inequality.
 
• The World Economic Forum was founded in 1971 by **Klaus Schwab** and has its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Economic Forum (WEF):**

 
 
• It is a Swiss-based international organization committed to improving the state of the world through public-private cooperation.
 
• WEF organizes annual meetings where global leaders collaborate to address global challenges.
 
• Key themes include sustainable development, digital transformation, and global economic trends.
 
 
 
• **Davos:**
 
 
• Davos is a mountain resort town in the Swiss Alps, known for hosting the annual WEF meetings since 1971.
 
• It is recognized for its high-altitude conference facilities and picturesque scenery.
 
• The event significantly impacts global decision-making and policy formulation.
 
 
 
• **Global Agenda of WEF:**
 
 
• Each WEF meeting focuses on addressing critical global issues such as climate change, technology, health crises, and geopolitical tensions.
 
• It brings together leaders from government, business, and civil society to foster collaboration and solutions.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Switzerland as a Host Country:**
 
 
• Switzerland is known for its neutrality and stability, making it an ideal location for hosting international events.
 
• The country's efficient infrastructure and commitment to sustainability align with the goals of the WEF.
